label: early-episode upcoming-a2 choice (GO, and rewarded D1)
explanation: Fires only at fixation-input steps (GO, and D1 only when the previous reward input is 1; never at D2 or at D1 after no reward), and almost only on trials where the agent is about to choose a2 (97% of mass; action at D1/GO is the agent own upcoming choice, which it computes, so no unobservable future variable is used). It is strongly gated by episode time: rate ~24% in trials 0-19, ~10% in 20-29, ~0 after trial 35, so it is a slowly decaying early-episode signal (correlated with start_high=0, i.e. S2 good early, and with since_rev=-1). GO carries 75% of mass; strongest activations are at GO with a strongly negative choice logit (favoring a2), and within runs of a2 choices the activation decays trial by trial. Predicate dev F1 0.72, mass recall 0.97; precision is limited (~0.6) because the episode-time cutoff is soft and many late early-episode a2 trials are below threshold. Tightening to ep_trial<20 gives precision 0.75 but recall 0.70. Small residual activations on a1 GO steps early in episodes.
